title: The Quiet Atlas
author: Orsen Brightwater
blurb: Lior Vasquez, a suffragist's driver who reads every letter before delivering it, has spent five years learning which silences keep people safe. Then the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must smuggle the evidence past three checkpoints, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
